## Name Spoofer certificate reliability

- Fixed the remaining Name Spoofer activation failure caused by Windows certificate trust timing and hidden confirmation prompts.
- The installer now prepares one persistent BondoMod certificate while it is already elevated, so manual activation and Windows background startup do not need another prompt.
- Name Spoofer now verifies the exact installed certificate before activating and keeps errors free of technical details.
- Restricted HTTPS interception to the exact Epic identity host used by Rocket League.
